issues.description: The problem statement/task requires implementing getters for each attribute (public access), but the solution declares some getters as private (specifically getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()). This visibility mismatch contradicts the exercise instructions and may confuse students about the expected API and prevent code/tests that rely on public getters from working as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all attribute getters public in the solution (and ensure the template prompts students to implement public getters). Specifically, change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public so they match the task description that asks for getters for every attribute.
